DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様のお預かりについてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss care for your child, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。仕事の休みが毎週変わります。月曜から金曜まで、いつも同じ利用日にはできないので相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事休みが毎週変わり子の利用日固定が難しいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My days off change every week. I cannot always use the same days from Monday to Friday, so I would like some advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your days off change weekly, making fixed childcare days difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今分かっている予定は、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the schedule you know so far?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来月の前半だけあります。曜日ではなく、日付で勤務表をもらいました。こちらを見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 来月前半のみの日付勤務表を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only for the first half of next month. My work schedule lists dates rather than weekdays. Please look at this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your date-based work schedule for only the first half of next month. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望の日と、まだ分からない日を分けて担当へ伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us tell the person in charge separately which days you want and which are still unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この印が勤務の日です。空欄の日は休みではなく、まだ予定が出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務印と予定未発表空欄を区別して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: These marks indicate workdays. Blank days are not days off; their schedules have not been announced yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between workday marks and blanks with unannounced schedules. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予定の変更や申込みの時期については、担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain schedule changes and when to apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。今日分かっている分を申し込めるのか、後半の予定が出るまで待つのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前半のみ申込可か後半判明まで待つか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I want to know whether I can apply for the days I know today or should wait until the second-half schedule comes out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can apply for the first half alone or must wait for the second half. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご質問と勤務表を、担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show your questions and work schedule to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。前半の必要な日と、後半が未定ということを一緒に説明します。勤務表は自分でも控えを残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要日と未定期間を説明し勤務表控えも残すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will explain both the days needed in the first half and that the second half is undecided. I will also keep a copy of the work schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the needed days and undecided period and keep a schedule copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当窓口へご案内します。ご相談にお越しいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you to the responsible desk. Thank you for coming to discuss this.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お待ちの間に、何かお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything I can help you with while you wait?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この椅子が思ったより低くて、立つ時に困りそうです。付き添いが戻るまで、呼ばれてもすぐ動けないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 低い待合椅子から立つのが難しく呼出後即移動できないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: This chair is lower than I expected, and standing up may be difficult. Until my companion returns, I may not be able to move immediately even if called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that rising from the low waiting-room chair is difficult and you cannot move immediately when called. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、無理に立ち上がらずにお待ちください。付き添いの方はどちらへ行かれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please wait without forcing yourself to stand. Where has your companion gone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付で支払いの相談をしています。私の鞄を持った、青い上着の人です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付相談中の付き添いの位置と外見を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are discussing payment at reception. They are wearing a blue jacket and carrying my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe your companion's location and appearance while they speak at reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付へお知らせします。立つ時に必要なお手伝いも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will inform reception. Let us also check what help you need to stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。いつもは肘掛けのある椅子を使っています。ここでは手をつく所が見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 普段肘掛け利用で今回手をつく場所がないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I usually use a chair with armrests. Here I cannot find anywhere to put my hands for support.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you normally use armrests but have nowhere to support your hands here. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お手伝いする職員が伺うまで、ここでお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you wait here until a staff member comes to help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。付き添いへ、私の所に戻ってほしいと伝えてください。私から遠くへ呼びに行くのは難しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分で呼びに行けず付き添いへ戻るよう連絡を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Please tell my companion to come back to me. It is difficult for me to go far to fetch them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for your companion to be told to return because you cannot go to fetch them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お伝えします。お荷物は、ご自身のお手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell them. Do you have your belongings with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 上着だけ膝にあります。鞄は付き添いが持っています。職員の方が来たら、どのように立つか相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 上着鞄の所在を示し職員と立ち方を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only my jacket is on my lap. My companion has my bag. When the staff member comes, I will discuss how to stand up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain where your jacket and bag are and say you will discuss standing with staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、付き添いの方へ連絡します。こちらでお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will contact your companion. Please wait here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 町内の行事についてのお尋ねですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about a neighborhood event, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。会場へ来る人に道を教える係になりました。交差点に立つ予定ですが、車も止める役なのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 町内来場者案内係が車を止める役もあるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have been assigned to give directions to people coming to the venue. I will stand at an intersection, but I do not know whether I am also supposed to stop cars.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the neighborhood event's visitor guide also has to stop cars. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行事の担当から、何を頼まれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What did the event organizer ask you to do?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口への道を案内してほしいと言われました。車を止める道具や、交通整理の説明は受けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 依頼は入口案内のみで交通整理説明未受領と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They asked me to show the way to the entrance. I have received neither equipment to stop cars nor instructions for directing traffic.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you were asked only to guide people to the entrance and received no traffic-control instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 来場者への道案内と、道路上で車の流れを変えることは別です。行事の担当にも役割を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Giving visitors directions and changing the flow of cars on a road are separate tasks. Please confirm your role with the event organizer too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、車へ手を出して止めず、歩く人へ会場の方向を伝える役として準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車を止めず歩行者へ会場方向を伝える役と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will prepare to tell pedestrians the direction of the venue, without putting my hand out to stop cars.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that your role is to direct pedestrians to the venue without stopping cars. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 立つ位置や、通行する方の邪魔にならない案内方法も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us also check where you will stand and how to guide people without obstructing passersby.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予定の場所は、この地図の角です。歩道が狭いので、別の案内位置に変えられるか担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 狭い歩道予定位置を地図で示し別位置相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The planned spot is this corner on the map. The sidewalk is narrow, so I will ask the organizer whether I can guide people from another spot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the planned spot on the narrow sidewalk on the map and ask about another location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した役割を、ほかの案内係にも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the other guides the role you have confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。同じ係の二人へ伝えます。場所と役割が決まってから、案内の紙を作ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他係二人へ役割を伝え位置確定後に案内紙を作ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will tell the other two people doing this job. Once the location and role are settled, I will make a directions sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the other two guides their role and make a directions sheet after the location is fixed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当の方とご確認ください。準備にお気をつけて。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please confirm this with the organizer. Take care with your preparations. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送後の控えについて、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about your dispatch receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人へ送った荷物の番号を知らせたいです。この紙には数字がたくさんあって、どれを伝えればよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送控えのどの数字を友人へ伝えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to tell my friend the number of the parcel I sent. There are many numbers on this paper, and I do not know which one to give them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which number on the dispatch receipt to tell your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの欄が、お荷物のお問い合わせに使う番号です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field is the number used for inquiries about your parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この長い番号ですね。下にある金額を番号だと思って送りかけました。教えてもらえて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 問合番号と金額を取り違えかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This long number, then. I nearly sent the amount below, thinking it was the number. Thank you for explaining.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you nearly confused the inquiry number with the amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号と、差し出した日も控えておくと確認しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Keeping the number and the date you sent it will make checking easier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日付はこちらですね。友人へは番号を一字ずつ写して送ります。紙全体の写真を送る必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送日も特定し全紙写真の必要性を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The date is here, right? I will copy the number character by character and send it to my friend. Do I need to send a photograph of the whole paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the dispatch date too and ask whether a photograph of the entire paper is necessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号をお伝えになる場合は、その部分を確認してお知らせいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: To give them the number, you can check that section and tell them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、番号と日付だけ送ります。この控えは自分が問い合わせる時にも使えるよう、手元に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号日付のみ送り控えは自分用に保持すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will send only the number and date. I will keep this receipt so I can use it if I need to make an inquiry myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will send only the number and date and keep the receipt for yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写した番号を、元の欄と見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please compare the number you copied with the original field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全部一致しました。友人へ送れました。控えは鞄の内ポケットへしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 転記番号を照合し送信して内ポケット収納すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It all matches. I have sent it to my friend. I will put the receipt in my bag's inside pocket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you checked the copied number, sent it, and will store the receipt in an inside pocket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、控えをなくさないようお持ちください。ご利用いただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep the receipt so you do not lose it. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 明細の表示について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about how the statement is displayed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この振込みの名前が途中までしか出ていません。誰からの入金か、長い名前を確認する方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入金表示名が途中までのため全名確認法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The name on this transfer is cut off. Is there a way to check the full long name to see who deposited the money?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to see the full name because the deposit name is cut off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その明細は、どちらでご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did you view that statement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯で見ました。画面を横にしても同じ所までなので、私が押す場所を見つけられないだけかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯横画面でも同じ表示で操作位置不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: On my phone. Turning the screen sideways shows only the same part, so perhaps I just cannot find where to tap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that landscape mode shows the same text and you cannot find the right control. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの案内では、取引の詳細を開いて確認できます。お手元の画面で、その項目を探しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: According to these instructions, you can open the transaction details to check. Let us find that item on your screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この行を開くのですね。金額を押していましたが、行全体から詳細へ進めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金額でなく取引行から詳細を開けたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I open this row, then. I was tapping the amount, but I could get to the details from the whole row.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you opened details from the transaction row rather than the amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 詳細に出た名前を、ご自身でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the name shown in the details yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社の名前が最後まで見えました。入金の日付も確認します。先月の行を見ていたので、今月の分へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社名と日付を見て先月行から今月行へ移ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see the company's full name. I will check the deposit date too. I was looking at last month's row, so I will return to this month's.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the company name and date and move from last month's row to this month's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じ名前でも、日付と金額を合わせて見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even if the name is the same, check the date and amount together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今月の行も開けました。名前、日付、金額を自分の記録に書けたので、家でも同じ方法で見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今月の名前日付金額を記録し自宅でも確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I opened this month's row too. I have written the name, date, and amount in my records, so I will use the same method at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you recorded this month's name, date, and amount and will check at home too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できてよかったです。それでは、携帯をお忘れなく。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am glad you could check. Please remember your phone. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの氷も、お持ち帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be taking this ice home too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、ほかの買物をまだ続けます。会計の直前まで売り場の冷凍庫に戻しておいてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 氷以外の買物継続のため会計直前まで冷凍保管を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I am still doing other shopping. May I put it back in the sales-floor freezer until just before checkout?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about keeping the ice frozen until checkout while continuing other shopping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の袋を確認します。まだ開けていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me check this bag. Have you not opened it yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開けていません。かごに入れてから時間がたったので、どこへ戻すか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋未開封だがかご滞在が長く戻す方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not opened it. It has been in my basket for a while, so I want to ask where to return it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the bag is unopened but has been in the basket a long time and ask how to return it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでお預かりして状態を確認します。お会計の前に、氷を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will take this and check its condition. Please choose your ice before checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。先に牛乳とパンを選び、最後に氷を取りに来ます。今の袋はこちらへ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現袋を職員へ渡し牛乳パン選択後に氷を取ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will choose milk and bread first, then come back for ice last. I will hand this bag to you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will hand the current bag to staff and get ice after choosing milk and bread. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ち帰りには、お時間がかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will it take long to get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 車で十五分ほどです。保冷袋を持って来たので、会計後はその袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車十五分で持参保冷袋を使用すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: About fifteen minutes by car. I brought an insulated bag, so I will put it in that after checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it is fifteen minutes by car and you will use the insulated bag you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、ほかのお買物が終わってからお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please come back when you have finished your other shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ほかの商品は選べました。氷を最後に取って、一緒に会計します。帰りに別の店へ寄るのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他商品選択後氷取得と寄道中止を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have chosen the other products. I will pick up the ice last and pay for everything together. I will skip stopping at another shop on the way home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will get ice after the other items and cancel your detour. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの氷をお選びください。それでは、お気をつけてお持ち帰りください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please choose your ice here. Take care taking it home. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 体操の集まりへご参加でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you joining the exercise gathering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は散歩の途中で見ています。犬が音に反応して吠えたので、ここで参加せずに帰ろうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散歩犬が音で吠え体操へ参加せず帰ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Today I am watching while out walking. My dog barked in reaction to the sound, so I think I will go home without joining here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your dog barked at the sound during your walk and you will go home without joining the exercise. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 周りの方から離れた所で、まず落ち着いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you first move away from the people around you and settle down?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらへ移ります。リードは持ったままです。犬を置いて私だけ集まりへ入ることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人から離れリード保持し犬を放置しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will move over here. I am keeping hold of the leash. I will not leave my dog and join the gathering alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will move away from people, hold the leash, and not leave the dog unattended. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかの参加者にも、近づかないようお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the other participants not to approach either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。触ればすぐ静かになると言うのは難しいので、見ているだけにしてもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 触れば静まる保証なく見守るだけをお願いする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I cannot say the dog will quiet down immediately if touched, so it would help if they would just watch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask people only to watch because touching the dog is no guarantee it will quiet down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 参加のご案内は、また別の時にもご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also check the participation information another time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 犬を連れずに来られる日に、参加できる時間を聞きたいです。今日は体操の説明を急いで聞かず、先に帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 犬なしの別日に参加時刻を聞き今日は先に帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: On a day I can come without my dog, I would like to ask what times I can join. Today I will go home first without rushing to hear the exercise explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask about participation times another day without the dog and go home first today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路の混雑にご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please watch out for crowding in the passageway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。人が少なくなってから、この脇を通ります。犬を近づけておわびするのでなく、離れたまま一言お礼を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 混雑が減って脇を通り離れて礼を伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will pass along this side once there are fewer people. Instead of bringing my dog closer to apologize, I will say a brief thank-you from a distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will pass along the side after the crowd thins and thank people from a distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご配慮いただきありがとうございます。それでは、落ち着いてお帰りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for being considerate. Please take your time going home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the ticket machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 切符は出ましたが、返却口に十円玉が一枚残っています。指が届きにくくて取れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切符購入後返却口の十円玉に指が届かないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My ticket came out, but one ten-yen coin remains in the return tray. My fingers cannot easily reach it, so I cannot take it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot reach the ten-yen coin in the return tray after buying a ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの返却口ですね。小さいふたを手前へ開けてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This return tray, correct? Try opening the little flap toward you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開きました。硬貨が端の方にあります。爪で押すと奥へ入りそうなので、やめました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ふたを開き端の硬貨を無理に押さなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It opened. The coin is at the edge. I stopped because pushing it with my nail seemed likely to send it farther inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you opened the flap and did not forcefully push the coin at the edge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 機械の中へ道具を入れず、そのままお待ちください。私が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait as it is without inserting any tool into the machine. I will check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。切符とほかのお釣りは、もう財布へ入れました。残っているのはこの一枚です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切符とほかの釣銭受取済で残り一枚と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I have already put the ticket and the rest of the change in my wallet. Only this one coin remains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you received the ticket and other change and only one coin remains. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取り出せました。こちらの十円玉をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I got it out. Please check this ten-yen coin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受け取りました。これで表示されたお釣りの額がそろいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 硬貨受領と釣銭額一致を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have received it. That makes the full amount of change displayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm receiving the coin and that the change amount matches. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに出てきていない物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything else that has not come out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全部そろいました。切符も一枚です。もう一度買わず、この切符で改札へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切符一枚と受取物がそろい改札へ行くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have everything. There is one ticket too. I will go to the gate with this ticket without buying another.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say all items and the one ticket are accounted for and you will go to the gate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お取りになれてよかったです。それでは、よい旅を。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am glad you could get it. Have a good trip. Travel safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の地図について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the neighborhood map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この地図を友達に渡したいです。私の集合住宅が大きく描かれていますが、入る所が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 集合住宅の入口が分からない配布地図を友人へ渡したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to give this map to my friend. My apartment complex is drawn large, but I cannot tell where to enter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to give your friend a distributed map that does not show the apartment entrance clearly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入口をご存じでしたら、ご自身の用の地図に印を付けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you know the entrance, you can mark it on the map for your own use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 西側の入口を使います。北側にも建物へ入れそうな道がありますが、そこは駐車場です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 西入口と北駐車場の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: We use the west entrance. There is also a path on the north that looks like it leads into the building, but that is the parking lot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the west entrance and north parking lot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地図の上では、この辺りが西側ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: On the map, this area is the west side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、ここです。入口の所へ矢印を描いて、駐車場の方へ曲がらないよう説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図の西入口へ矢印を加えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, here. I will draw an arrow at the entrance and explain not to turn toward the parking lot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will add an arrow at the west entrance on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お渡しする地図に、待ち合わせ場所も書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you also like to write the meeting place on the map you give them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書きたいです。玄関の中ではなく、入口の外で私が迎えに行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口外で本人を迎える待合場所を書きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will go to meet them outside the entrance, not inside the lobby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to mark a meeting place outside the entrance where you will meet your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、配布用をもう一枚お持ちください。今の紙を見ながら書けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then please take another copy for distribution. You can write on it while looking at this one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。新しい紙に入口と待つ場所を描きます。住所も一緒に送り、友達が来る前に分かるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新配布紙へ入口待合を書き住所も友人へ送ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will draw the entrance and waiting place on the new sheet. I will send the address too and ask whether my friend understands before they come.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will mark the entrance and meeting place on a new map and send your friend the address too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらをお使いください。楽しいお集まりになりますように。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use this one. I hope you have a pleasant gathering. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日の検査のご準備はよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you ready for today's examination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 検査前の食事について確認したいです。紙を見直して、朝食を取ってはいけなかったかもしれないと気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査前に食事を取った可能性を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to check about eating before the examination. Rereading the instructions, I realized I might not have been allowed breakfast.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you may have eaten before the examination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご案内の紙を見せていただけますか。今朝は何を召し上がりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see the instruction sheet? What did you have this morning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: パン一枚と牛乳です。七時半ごろに食べました。こちらが検査の案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内紙とパン牛乳と七時半の食事を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: One slice of bread and milk. I ate around seven thirty. Here are the examination instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the instructions and state you had bread and milk at seven thirty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 食事の内容と時刻を、検査の担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the examination staff what you ate and at what time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。家を出てからは、何も食べていません。今から検査を受けられるかを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家を出た後は未摂取で本日検査可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I have not eaten anything since leaving home. I want to ask whether I can have the examination now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have eaten nothing since leaving home and ask whether today's examination is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本日できる検査や今後の予定は、担当が確認してご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will check and explain which examinations can be done today and the plans from here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分で帰らず、説明を待ちます。今日休みを取ったので、できることがあれば知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己帰宅せず説明を待ち今日可能な内容を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will wait for the explanation instead of going home on my own. I took today off, so I would like to know if anything can be done.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for the explanation without going home yourself and want to know what is possible today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらでお待ちください。担当が来たら、同じ内容をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait here. Tell the staff member the same information when they come.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。食べた物と七時半の時刻をもう一度伝えます。次回の予定が必要なら、その場で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当へ食事内容時刻を再伝達し必要時次回を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will tell them again what I ate and that it was seven thirty. If another appointment is needed, I will discuss it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will repeat the food and time to the staff and discuss the next appointment if necessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当をお呼びします。それでは、こちらでお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will call the person in charge. Please wait here. Excuse me.
